newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to leave hospital temporarily on Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to leave hospital temporarily on Sunday.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin, who underwent heart surgery nearly two weeks ago, plans to leave the hospital where he has been recuperating and go to a government sanatorium outside Moscow, Itar-Tass news agency said.
Tass quoted Yeltsin's surgeon, Renat Akchurin, as saying Yeltsin would go for an hour's walk at the Barvikha sanatorium. It was not clear whether he would then return to hospital.
Interfax news agency later quoted Akchurin as saying that Yeltsin would just spend a little while at Barvikha and move there permanently on Thursday or Friday.
"The president's recuperation is going well. The president is active, Today he is going for a walk at the dacha in Barvikha, to be in normal surroundings for a while," it quoted him as saying.
Akchurin said Yeltsin, 65, had lost weight but had got stronger since the operation on November 5.

He also said that scarring on Yeltsin's heart revealed during the bypass surgery backed up his earlier view that the president had suffered a third, unannounced heart attack shortly before the run-off vote in which he won a second term.
